DD should be made in favour of

Senior Divisional finance Manager Bhusawal payable at Bhusawal . Successful Bidder has to upload scanned copy of the FDR document in place of PBG and has to ensure delivery of hard copy of Original FDR to the Buyer within 15 days of award of contract. 7.
